result.summary: Despite the page-load framing, this 10.6s capture (Fenix Nightly 144, Android 16, PowerVR GPU) shows a scroll interaction on mastodon.social after load: 499 scroll, 280 mozvisualscroll and 13 touchmove DOM events, with no page-load or navigation markers on any thread. Most of the cost is in the GPU process Renderer thread. 346 composites between t=2.60s and t=10.02s keep it busy for 7.08s of that 7.43s window (avg 20.45ms per composite), while WebRender's render backend builds the same 346 frames in 2.31ms on average. Inside the composites, about 70% of samples end in kernel-wait leaf frames (futex, ioctl, poll) under RenderThread::UpdateAndRender, and only a few dozen samples land in WebRender or GL driver code. The one GL operation the markers can pin a wait to is glDeleteTextures: 219 calls of ≥1ms total 955.6ms (≈13.5% of composite time), and 72% of samples inside them are in ioctl, with a PowerVR RM_WaitUntilResourceIsNotNeededOnUsage frame seen. Separately, the content main thread has one 443ms long task (BHR hang) at t=1.95s, which is site JavaScript handling the /api/v2/notifications XHR loadend.
result.hot_path: RenderThread::UpdateAndRender (GPU process Renderer) → [missing native frames] → libc __futex_wait_ex / ioctl / poll; part of it attributable via 'OpenGL Calls: delete_textures' markers (219 calls ≥1ms, 955.6ms total)
result.recommendation: Re-capture on this device with native stack walking working on the GPU-process Renderer thread (or with simpleperf), so the futex/ioctl waits can be tied to specific GL/EGL calls. In the same capture, check whether texture deletions during scroll can be deferred or pooled, given that delete_textures alone accounts for ~956ms of composite time.

result.headline: While scrolling the Mastodon timeline, the GPU-process Renderer thread takes a median 20.8ms per frame, missing 16.7ms on 80% of composites, and about 70% of that time ends in PowerVR-driver futex/ioctl/poll waits rather than WebRender CPU work.
key_figures: 3,983 of 5,700 Renderer samples inside Composite end in libc futex (1,737) / ioctl (1,651) / poll (399) / close (196)
219 delete_textures GL calls ≥1ms total 955.6ms (max 17.2ms); 618 of 862 samples inside them are in ioctl
result.main_limitation: Renderer stacks are broken (only the UpdateAndRender label frame plus the libc leaf survive), so apart from delete_textures the profile cannot show which GL or EGL call each futex/ioctl wait belongs to.
result.evidence:
Threads: p-6 GPU Process. t-16 Renderer 4,087ms CPU, t-18 WRRenderBackend#2 681ms, t-15 Compositor 347ms. p-4 mastodon.social content t-10 GeckoMain 1,843ms CPU. Parent GeckoMain 406ms.

Renderer (t-16), full profile: 7,705 samples, 1,990 idle. 5,700 non-idle samples fall inside 'Composite #2' markers. Leaf self-time inside Composite: libc fun_9cec4 under __futex_wait_ex/pthread_mutex_unlock 1,737 (30.5%); fun_de084 under ioctl 1,651 (29.0%, including fSwapBuffersWithDamage ~2.6% and fQuerySurface ~1.1%); fun_e0304 under poll 399 (7.0%); android_fdsan_close_with_tag 196 (3.4%). PowerVR GLES frames (PrepareToDraw 96, GLES3EmitState 90, LoadTextureState 39, …) are each under 2%. Searching 'webrender' finds 91 functions, all with ≤11 total samples.

Composite markers: 346, sum 7,075.8ms over 2.596s–10.024s; p50 20.8ms, p90 27.4ms, min 2.0ms, max 38.4ms. 276 are >16.7ms, 5 are >33ms. Render reasons: ASYNC_IMAGE 346, VSYNC 344, ANIMATED_PROPERTY 221, SCENE 101. NumDrawCalls p50 105, max 137. NumPictureCacheInvalidated: 11 on most of 333 frames (p50 = p90 = max = 11).

OpenGL Calls markers (only calls ≥1ms are recorded): 359 in total. delete_textures 219 calls / 955.6ms / max 17.2ms; draw_elements_instanced 42 / 63.4ms; clear 45 / 58.7ms; tex_sub_image_2d_pbo 11 / 21.0ms; the rest are each under 20ms. Samples inside delete_textures markers: 862, of which ioctl 618 (71.7%) and futex 163 (18.9%); RM_WaitUntilResourceIsNotNeededOnUsage appears in 2 samples.

WRRenderBackend#2 (t-18): BuildFrame 346 markers, avg 2.31ms, max 8.0ms. Batching avg 0.48ms, UpdateVisibility avg 0.51ms.

Content t-10: 2,889 active samples. RefreshDriverTick 347 markers, avg 3.2ms, max 20.2ms. Longest task: m-14 CompleteResumeRunnable / XHR loadend at t=1.949s, 442.96ms (LongTask, Jank, BHR-detected hang); 369 of 370 samples are under js::RunScript in mastodon.social code, following the 825.7ms /api/v2/notifications request.
result.caveats:
- This is not a page-load capture. It shows scrolling after load, so page-load reference points do not apply. Against the 16.7ms frame budget the p50 composite is about 1.25x over: a modest, sustained overrun rather than a stall.
- Native stack walking on the Renderer thread is broken. Samples contain only the RenderThread::UpdateAndRender label frame plus a libc leaf PC (plus some unsymbolicated 0x… roots). The calls leading into the futex, ioctl and poll waits are therefore unknown, except where an 'OpenGL Calls' marker covers the sample. That marker type only records calls ≥1ms, so short waits go unattributed.
- Reading these leaf frames as waiting on the GPU or driver is an inference from the symbols (futex/ioctl in a PowerVR process) and from the CPU accounting (4.09s of thread CPU against ~7.9s of non-idle sampled wall time). It is not shown directly.
- The link between delete_textures and a driver wait for in-flight GPU resources is a hypothesis. It rests on the ioctl share inside those markers and 2 samples of RM_WaitUntilResourceIsNotNeededOnUsage.
- The constant 11 picture-cache tile invalidations per frame and the ASYNC_IMAGE render reason on every frame are observed, but I did not establish whether they are expected while scrolling.
- 514 content-thread samples attributed to 'Task LayerActivityTracker' → pthread_mutex_unlock contradict that task's markers (63 runnables, 1.6ms total). I treated them as a sampling artifact and did not count them.
- This is a single capture on a single PowerVR device, with no other-browser or other-GPU comparison.
